description: Encode the sound again at a bitrate, in the same format. WAV, FLAC and AIFF have no bitrate. Takes audio files. Needs FFmpeg.

kbps.description: Kilobits per second, 8 to 512 (64: speech; 128: music online; 320: the most MP3 holds).

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results; default: the user's setting.

name: audio_bitrate
title: Change the bitrate
